public.text: The architecture discusses agents, assistive AI and clinical applications but does not clearly represent orchestration among a local facility, an AI service and a remote specialist. A model output is not a completed clinical service.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a workflow-orchestration pattern that records task assignment, priority, status, clinician acceptance, critical-result communication, exception handling and final responsibility across distributed teams.
